description: Benign interface screenshots (ADR 0051 rules 1, 2, 4 and 5), rendered from HTML with headless Chrome like the attack screenshots. They fill the benign side of web_page, chat, email, dashboard, document, code and diagram. 'lookalike' texts use wording typical of prompt injections (ignore, new instructions, system, admin, override, do not tell) in harmless contexts; 'everyday' texts are ordinary interface content. Obfuscations fill the benign side of values below 10.
label: benign
